fix(test): a timeout says whether the test waited or the machine was slow; crash-order kills its fixture however the test ends (rich-test-suite-czqk)

A timed-out test's failure now carries the worker's CPU over the test's
time and the machine's load average (test/suite/timeout-report.ts, wired
in vitest.config.ts beside the one hang budget), so a red run tells a
hang from a loaded machine without a rerun. The example-runner timeouts
the ticket saw did not reproduce here: 36 busy loops on 12 cores slowed
the file 2.6x (84 s) with no test near 30 s.

crash-order's fixture runs in its own process group, outside the runner's,
so a test that failed or timed out before it exited left it running with
its rich-app-* directory. runApp now registers stop() with onTestFinished:
kill the group, wait for its end, remove the directory. Scripted repro (a
2 s-timeout test over the `signal` ending): the old file leaves the process
and directory, the new one neither.

fix(text): measurement agrees with what is drawn (rich-text-z3ln) (#294)

* fix(text): measurement agrees with what is drawn (rich-text-z3ln)

- RichText.measure takes its minimum from wrap's `widestWord`, the same word
  `divideLine` never breaks, so a line's indent counts. Deliberate divergence
  from Rich, whose measure drops the indent its wrapper keeps.
- One `expandTabs` in cells.ts, called by RichText and Syntax: a tab reaches the
  next tab stop (Rich's `Text.expand_tabs`). It also maps offsets, so a span
  after a tab now styles the characters it named instead of landing short.
- No site outside `Measurement.get` decides the fallback for a renderable that
  cannot measure itself. Viewport and Constrain floored that minimum at 1;
  it is now Rich's 0.

* fix(text): review — tab size is checked, Constrain/Align measure as Rich does, whitespace keeps its width (rich-text-z3ln)

expandTabs refuses a tabSize that is not a positive integer (it silently
dropped spans at 0) and measures a piece only when a tab follows it.
Constrain measures its content at the constrained width; Align returns the
content's measurement unchanged. Whitespace-only text takes its width as
its minimum, as in Rich.

* fix(text): tab size is parsed where it is given (rich-text-z3ln)

A TabSize brand, made only by parseTabSize, is what expandTabs takes;
RichText and Syntax parse at construction, so a bad tabSize fails at the
constructor rather than at the first render, tab or no tab.
